{{Quote|Actually, perhaps you might help. It appears our offworld tour group from Duzay has gone astray from their scheduled nature walk.|[[Rovim Minnoni]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Rovim Minnoni|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Duzay''' was a world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of tourists from Duzay sojourned at the [[Lake Retreat Hotel]] during their stay on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. An employee of the hotel named [[Rovim Minnoni]] recruited a spacer to rescue these tourists when they got lost during a walk in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG" />
